title: P2556 - P2556
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Faulty Engine Coolant Level Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G32)
Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri or power/ground issues to those components
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Engine Coolant Level Sensör Okuma Değerleri (G32), Engine Temperature Control Actuator (N493) in addition to the related wiring per the repair manual.
technicalNotes:
At face value you would initially believe this DTC is for the Engine Coolant Level Sensör Okuma Değerleri however in most cases that sensor is wired to the 17-Gösterge Paneli or the 09-Central Elektroniği.  The Coolant Level Sensör Okuma Değerleri is not usually wired directly to the 01-Engine Kontrol Modülü.  In those cases the thermostat (N493) and the wiring to it should be checked as per post #8 in this thread: https://forums.ross-tech.com/index.php?threads/28967/
The example vehicle would use this generation 09-Cent. Elect. module MLB based Cent. Elect. (J519) BCM1 and measuring block group 028.1 can be used to Kontrol edin: the Coolant Level (G32) status.
model: 911, Passat, Golf, Tiguan, Polo, Arteon, Touareg, Transporter, Caddy, Amarok, Scirocco, Jetta, A3, A4, A5, A6, A7, A8, Q3, Q5, Q7, Q8, TT, Leon, Ibiza, Ateca, Arona, Tarraco, Octavia, Superb, Kodiaq, Karoq, Fabia, Scala, Cayenne, Macan, Panamera, Taycan
